content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for BRIC ILS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for BRIC ILS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 05 October 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue well before the scheduled time to complete the registration process.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the BRIC ILS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Project Scientist - I, Senior Research Fellow / Senior Project Associate, and Technician positions in the BRIC ILS Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Scientist - I post?
faq.answer: For the Project Scientist - I position, candidates must possess a Doctoral degree in science or a Master's degree in Engineering or Technology. Publications in peer-reviewed journals are encouraged.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Technician post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Technician post is 30 years. For other posts, the maximum age limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow / Senior Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Senior Research Fellow / Senior Project Associate position will receive a salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month plus 18% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the BRIC ILS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any of the posts. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the BRIC ILS Recruitment 2026 will be based on a walk-in interview. Candidates need to attend the interview with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the BRIC Institute of Life Sciences, Bhubaneswar, Odisha. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is being conducted through a walk-in interview. Candidates are required to attend the interview directly with their filled application form and necessary documents.
